requirements.verbatim_quote:
When an individual executes a series of signings during a single, continuous period of
controlled system access, the first signing shall be executed using all electronic signature
components
requirements.atomic_statement: In a continuous controlled-access session, the first signing shall use all electronic signature components.
requirements.subject: the individual
conditions: single continuous period of controlled system access

requirements.verbatim_quote:
subsequent signings shall be executed using at least one electronic signature
component that is only executable by, and designed to be used only by, the individual
requirements.atomic_statement: In a continuous controlled-access session, subsequent signings shall be executed using at least one electronic signature component executable only by, and designed only for, that individual.
requirements.subject: the individual
conditions: single continuous period of controlled system access
